verdicts.reason: A keeps a clean one-line headline and a well-spaced CTA. However, the 'Longest Day Sale' ribbon shrinks to a tiny badge stuck in the top-right corner, losing its role as a hook. The legal line also moves above the CTA at nearly the same size as the subcopy and sits over the speckled circle. B keeps the ribbon large, but it clashes with the logo, which moves off-axis to the top-right. The headline wraps badly and leaves 'last' orphaned on its own line. The headline, subcopy, oversized legal text and CTA are jammed together with almost no gaps, while a dead band is left at the bottom.
